description: One customer produces many short incidents (flaps) and alerts from one monitor. A suspended customer with even more flaps is not part of the signals.

canned.headline: [[C1]] is the noisiest customer of the week.
points: [[C1]] had {{C1.noise.incidents}} incidents in {{rule.window_days}}, {{C1.noise.flaps}} of them flaps ({{C1.noise.flap_share}}), and {{C1.noise.alerts}} alerts.
[[M1]] alone accounts for {{M1.incidents}} incidents; a higher failure threshold could reduce the noise.
